name: "No Gimmicks Necessary" Al Robertson
caption: ICTC's own founder and host, who unveiled the tournament's 24-man, three-division bracket at its own founding press conference.

identity.note: Shares a name with al-robertson-rspwf, known only from an RSPWF Top 200 placing (1998, #164, tagged LWC/UEW) with no tenure of its own. No shared federation tag, roster, or crossover document found linking that placing to ICTC — a bare name match is not evidence of a join under the identity-join test, so this stays distinct pending any actual corroboration.

tenures.source: ICTC's own founding press conference (msg_id ybU38G37TR8J, 24 October 1998): hosts the announcement of all three divisional brackets from the podium.
